title: OneCore
description: OneCore is an all-in-one Minecraft server core that replaces dozens of plugins!
body:
Running a Minecraft server often means installing dozens of plugins just to cover basic features. You add one plugin to fix a problem, another plugin stops working. You update a dependency, and suddenly something no longer supports your server version. Over time, plugin conflicts, performance issues, and scattered configurations become the real challenge.
OneCore was created to solve this problem.
OneCore is an all-in-one Minecraft server core that replaces many commonly used plugins by providing essential systems in a single, unified plugin. Instead of managing multiple permission, utility, chat, economy, and admin plugins, everything is handled through one consistent framework.
What OneCore Provides
OneCore includes the core features most servers rely on every day:
A built-in roles and permissions system with inheritance, priorities, temporary roles, and GUI management
Player utilities such as homes, warps, teleport requests, kits, nicknames, and AFK handling
A complete chat system with private messages, reply, ignore, staff chat, role-based formatting, and basic spam control
A Vault-compatible economy with balance management, payments, and admin controls
Admin and staff tools including player inspection, vanish, freeze, lag monitoring, announcements, and titles
A shared GUI framework used across all modules for consistent menus
Modular design with the ability to enable or disable features without restarting the server
All systems are designed to work together natively, eliminating the conflicts and inconsistencies that occur when combining many separate plugins.
Why Use OneCore
OneCore focuses on stability, performance, and simplicity. By consolidating core functionality into a single codebase, servers benefit from fewer compatibility issues, reduced overhead, and easier maintenance. Configuration is centralized, permissions are consistent, and updates are easier to manage.
This is not a plugin pack or a collection of loosely connected features. OneCore is a server core intended to act as the foundation of your setup.
Designed for Real Servers
Whether you are running a small survival server, an SMP, or a growing community, OneCore provides the essential systems needed to operate smoothly without unnecessary complexity. The free version is fully usable and designed to stand on its own, while the architecture allows for future expansion without breaking existing setups.commands-Roles & Permissions
/role create <name>
Creates a new role.
/role delete <name>
Deletes an existing role.
/role set <player> <role>
Sets a player’s primary role.
/role add <player> <role>
Adds an additional role to a player.
/role temp <player> <role> <time>
Assigns a role to a player temporarily.
/role inherit <role> <parent>
Makes one role inherit permissions from another role.
/role info <role>
Shows detailed information about a role.
/role gui
Opens the role management GUI.
Player Utilities
Homes & Warps
/sethome [name]
Sets a home location.
/home [name]
Teleports to a home location.
/delhome [name]
Deletes a home location.
/setwarp <name>
Creates a warp point.
/warp <name>
Teleports to a warp.
/delwarp <name>
Deletes a warp.
Teleportation
/spawn
Teleports the player to the server spawn.
/back
Returns the player to their previous location.
/tpa <player>
Sends a teleport request to another player.
/tpaccept
Accepts a pending teleport request.
/tpdeny
Denies a pending teleport request.
Player Commands
/kit [name]
Claims a kit.
/kit create <name>
Creates a new kit.
/nick <name>
Changes the player’s nickname.
/afk
Toggles AFK status.
Chat & Social
/msg <player> <message>
Sends a private message to another player.
/reply <message>
Replies to the last private message received.
/ignore <player>
Ignores messages from a specific player.
/staffchat
Toggles staff-only chat mode.
/slowchat <seconds>
Enables slow mode in chat.
World & Protection
/region create <name>
Creates a protected region.
/region delete <name>
Deletes a region.
/region info <name>
Shows information about a region.
/region flag <name> <flag> <value>
Sets a rule for a region (build, break, interact, pvp, etc.).
/spawnprotect
Toggles spawn protection.
Economy
Player Economy
/bal
Shows the player’s balance.
/pay <player> <amount>
Sends money to another player.
Admin Economy
/eco give <player> <amount>
Gives money to a player.
/eco take <player> <amount>
Removes money from a player.
/eco set <player> <amount>
Sets a player’s balance.
Shops
/shop
Opens the shop GUI.
/sell
Opens the sell GUI.
Automation / Rules (Lite)
/rule create
Creates a new automation rule.
/rule edit <id>
Edits an existing rule.
/rule delete <id>
Deletes a rule.
/rule list
Lists all rules.
/rule toggle <id>
Enables or disables a rule.
Admin & Staff Tools
/inspect <player>
Displays detailed information about a player.
/vanish
Toggles invisibility.
/freeze <player>
Freezes or unfreezes a player.
/staffmode
Enables staff mode tools.
/cmdspy
Allows staff to see player commands.
/lag
Displays server performance information.
UI & Quality of Life
/scoreboard
Toggles the scoreboard display.
/tab reload
Reloads the tab list formatting.
/announce <message>
Broadcasts a message to all players.
/title <player> <text>
Sends a title message to a player.
